safety_health_committee_001.evidence: FTA and the District shall form a School Climate and Safety Committee (SCSC) to address safety concerns.

safety_assault_protection_002.evidence: If a unit member is attacked, assaulted or physically threatened by a student while on duty, the unit member shall report the incident in full detail to his/her immediate supervisor within 24 hours of the incident. ... If a unit member leaves work during the instructional day due to the unit member being physically assaulted by a student, the District shall pay the teacher their regular pay, and the unit member shall not be charged accrued time for the remaining part of that duty day.

safety_student_discipline_003.evidence: A unit member may suspend a student from his/her class for the day of the incident and the day following for any act which would serve as a basis for suspension and/or expulsion under Education Code section 48900. The unit member shall immediately report the suspension to the site administration and send the student to the site administrator for appropriate action.

safety_remove_student_004.evidence: A unit member may suspend a student from his/her class for the day of the incident and the day following for any act which would serve as a basis for suspension and/or expulsion under Education Code section 48900.
